title: Zion's Revelation of Christ
english: You prepared a meal, but Zion brought it to the altar.
You hid Jesus in swaddling clothes, but she revealed his side to Thomas when he desired to touch it.
You have a virgin giving birth with the organs of nature having been shut up, but she received the bridegroom inside closed doors and had him.
translator_notes: The Greek text begins mid-sentence and ends mid-sentence.
The final clause is an edge fragment.
baehrens: PG 93; Homilia i in sanctum Lazarum (Khazarzar) u01 rem early

title: Leadership and Judgment in the New Jerusalem
english: A servant and brother, leader of the new Jerusalem, ruler of priests, chief of apostles, prominent among leaders, shining among lamps, and outshining among stars.
Peter speaks, but James legislates, and few words have settled the matter’s extent: ‘I judge that we should not trouble those from the nations’.
‘I judge’ — the one who utters these words does not reject this judgment, nor does he invalidate it.
translator_notes: The Greek text begins mid-sentence with δοῦλον καὶ ἀδελφόν and ends mid-sentence with οὗ τὴν κρῑσιν ἀθετεῖν οὐ, indicating a fragmentary passage.
baehrens: PG 93; Homilia i in sanctum Lazarum (Khazarzar) u01 rem mid

title: The Instrument of Judgment
english: It is not right to despise the judgment, for the judge of all, both dead and living, speaks through me (Acts 10:42).
My instrument is mine, but the craftsman is above me.
I offer the tongue, but the creator Word supplies the speech.
Pay no attention to the reed, but to the one writing.
translator_notes: The text begins mid-sentence: ...θέμις, οὐδὲ φαυλίζειν τὸ ψήφισμα...
baehrens: PG 93; Homilia i in sanctum Lazarum (Khazarzar) u01 rem close
